question: 在匹配模型、代码任务与计算预算时，基于符号语义等价类的输出不确定性，能否比 token 概率、文本/代码嵌入或 CodeBLEU 不确定性更稳定地预测代码正确性，并推广到程序修复、翻译和仓库级任务？
competing_hypotheses: H1: 准确的语义等价聚类能在不同模型和代码任务中持续改善不确定性—正确性关联。
H2: 现有收益取决于 LiveCodeBench、受限候选程序和有界符号执行；真实修复任务中的可扩展性/超时会消除收益。
H3: 任务行为测试或外部验证比任何模型自不确定性信号更可靠，或两者须组合。
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; research question synthesized from method-dependent evidence tension; not a claim that the literature is settled

sources.title: Look Before You Leap: An Exploratory Study of Uncertainty Analysis for Large Language Models
sources.claim: The study reports heterogeneous AUC by model/task and states uncertainty does not necessarily indicate correctness; subtle code errors are difficult, and repair/translation merit further work.

sources.title: Assessing Correctness in LLM-Based Code Generation via Uncertainty Estimation
sources.claim: Embedding- and CodeBLEU-based clustering did not show significant correctness correlation, while symbolic-execution-based clustering did on LiveCodeBench; equivalence checking is bounded/time-limited and abstention is evaluated using train/validation splits.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: Use the same open models and held-out tasks for code generation, repair, translation, and repository-level changes. Compare log-probability, embedding, CodeBLEU, bounded symbolic equivalence at predeclared timeouts, test-based behavioral uncertainty, and combined policies. Report AUROC/AUPRC, calibration, risk-coverage, abstention false-positive/negative rates, verification cost, and timeout rate with project-level splits.

question: 在控制训练事实分布、桥接实体熟悉度和提示预算后，LLM 的无 CoT 两跳推理表现是否主要由预训练桥接知识驱动，而非可迁移的组合推理能力？
competing_hypotheses: H1: 模型具备可泛化的潜在组合推理能力，只是需特定训练/检索条件触发。
H2: 已报告的成功主要来自自然语言预训练中熟悉的桥接事实；全合成事实下能力接近机会水平。
H3: 任务构造、数据混合比例或评价捷径解释了不同设置间的落差。
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; one study contains sharply contrasting experimental conditions; independent replication not yet located

sources.title: Lessons from Studying Two-Hop Latent Reasoning
sources.role: contrasting conditions within the same study
sources.claim: The paper reports near-zero no-CoT two-hop results in a fully synthetic setup but above-chance performance when newly taught facts connect to pretrained real-world knowledge; authors identify the difference as unresolved and note toy-task limitations.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: Factorially manipulate bridge-entity familiarity, synthetic/natural fact composition, training mixture, distractors, and chain-of-thought availability; preregister chance baselines and evaluate on held-out entities and relation types across model families.

question: 在相同 CPU-hours、种子语料与目标程序下，稀有分支优先的灰盒模糊测试能否跨不同类型程序稳定增加独特缺陷发现，而非仅在部分目标提高代码覆盖率？
competing_hypotheses: H1: 稀有分支定向的 seed 选择与变异能在多种目标上提高深路径探索，并带来更多真实缺陷。
H2: 收益强烈依赖目标程序、输入格式、编译插桩与并行配置；覆盖率提升不一定对应更多漏洞/缺陷。
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; original evaluation and implementation caveats verified; independent follow-up conflict search pending

sources.title: FairFuzz: Targeting Rare Branches to Rapidly Increase Greybox Fuzz Testing Coverage
sources.claim: Authors report faster/high coverage on some evaluated programs, not a uniform benchmark-wide result; they did not evaluate one proposed parallel laf-intel configuration because their implementation lacked distributed rare-branch computation.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: Run FairFuzz-style rare-branch prioritization and contemporary baselines over a predeclared diverse target suite, with identical CPU-hours, seeds, compiler/instrumentation, and repetitions. Separate coverage, unique crashes, deduplicated root causes, and confirmed vulnerabilities; report target-level uncertainty.

question: 单语种、单语句 bug 模板在 Java 项目中识别出的缺陷比例，能否预测现代多语言仓库中模板修复方法的真实召回率和安全收益？
competing_hypotheses: H1: 常见局部错误模式具有跨项目/跨语言稳定性，模板可覆盖可观比例的真实缺陷。
H2: 观察比例受 Java、热门仓库、commit-message 挖掘规则和单语句筛选限制，不能外推到一般软件缺陷或修复收益。
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; one dataset paper directly states external-validity limits; contradictory cross-language evidence still needed

sources.title: How Often Do Single-Statement Bugs Occur? The ManySStuBs4J Dataset
sources.claim: Authors report 153,652 mined single-statement fixes from 1,000 Java projects and 33.47% template matching in the large version; they acknowledge heuristic false positives, lack of severity annotation, and Java-only scope.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: Rebuild analogous mined and manually audited samples in Java, Python, JavaScript, and C/C++; stratify by repository age/size and bug severity; evaluate template-match prevalence, repair pass rate, regression rate, and repository-held-out generalization.
